meta.title: INSIDUS — From the Chilean Pacific to the world
meta.description: Seafood export from Chile. Jumbo squid, Chilean seabass, swordfish, hake, pomfret, rock crab and abalone.
meta.productDesc: {name} ({trade}, {bino}). South Pacific species processed for export by INSIDUS.

ocean.title: Cold water, demanding raw material
ocean.body: The Humboldt Current runs north along the Chilean coast and keeps the water cold year round. That temperature is what sets the texture and firmness of everything that comes out of it. We work with what the ocean gives, and do not force it.

about.title: INSIDUS
about.p1: We come out of the fishing trade: years of dealing directly with landing coves, plants and buyers, and the judgement you only get from watching product pass through your hands.
about.p2: We specialise in South Pacific species bound for demanding markets. Each shipment is defined by species, format and destination — not by catalogue.
about.p3: Our job is that a buyer on the other side of the world receives exactly what was agreed, in the condition it was agreed.

products.title: Our products
products.lead: South Pacific species, selected and processed for export.

process.title: From ocean to world
process.lead: Eight stages between the water and the port of destination.
stages: Species, area and season are settled before a shipment is committed.
Received with traceability from the landing point.
Sorted by size, condition and destination.
Cutting and grading by staff specialised in each format.
Format and labelling to the destination's requirement.
Followed through to the port of destination.

quality.title: Quality without compromise
quality.lead: Control is not a stage. It runs through all of them.
items: Controlled, unbroken temperature from reception to shipment.
Condition, grading and weight verified on every lot.
Health and origin certificates per destination.

trace.title: Where each lot comes from
trace.lead: Every shipment can be followed back to its origin.
items: The cove or port of reception is recorded.
Identified by date, species and shift.
Temperature logged and verified at each handover.

reach.title: From Chile to the world
reach.lead: Origin in the South Pacific; destination wherever the buyer needs it.
reach.note: Destination markets are set per shipment. Editable field.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.lead: Tell us the species, format and volume. We reply with availability and pricing.
contact.name: Name

statement.line: The water sets the standard. Our work is not to lose it on the way.

film.line: Everything that happens between the water and the container.

partners.title: A partner, not an occasional supplier
partners.lead: What a buyer needs to hold over time.
items: We plan by season and species, not by one-off opportunity.
The same grade and the same condition, shipment after shipment.
Consolidation, documentation and dispatch to the destination port.
We would rather build an annual programme than a single deal.
